build_init_weights_send_group: build a call to trigger_init_weights_send_group_for_remote_instance_request to initialize a NCCL weight-sending group on a seed instance
run_trigger_weights_transfer: run trigger_transferring_weights_request to send model weights from a seed instance to a remote instance
test_get_transfer_engine_info: test get_remote_instance_transfer_engine_info_per_rank to fetch transfer engine metadata for a given TP rank
build_register_memory_region: build a call to register_memory_region to register model weights as transferable memory regions
review_register_memory_region_v2: review register_memory_region_v2 to register weights using CUDA memory snapshot for merged block registration
